description: Figure 2 is a pie chart illustrating the distribution of samples across nine capabilities within the MULTITURNINSTRUCT dataset. The chart consists of nine slices, each representing a different capability. Starting from the largest slice and proceeding clockwise, the capabilities and their approximate proportions are: Reasoning (approximately 20%), Instruction Following (approximately 16%), Personalization (approximately 11%), Dynamic Environment (approximately 10%), Recursive Reasoning (approximately 10%), Memorization (approximately 10%), Multitasking (approximately 9%), Privacy Protection (approximately 8%), and Context Retrieval (approximately 8%). The slices are visually ordered from largest to smallest. Each slice is labeled with the capability name and includes a numerical value, presumably representing the number of samples. A legend is present, associating each capability with a distinct color. Percentage labels are not displayed directly within the slices, but the numerical values are visible on each slice. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
